lines.text: God tells Ezekiel to take up a lament for the princes of Israel, whose mother was a lioness.
The first young lion learns to tear his prey, is trapped in the nations' pit, and is led to Egypt.
The mother takes another cub, and he breaks down strongholds and devastates cities.
The nations net the second young lion, cage him with hooks, and bring him to the king of Assyria.
The fruitful vine is uprooted, its fruit dried by the west wind, and it is planted in the wilderness.
